correctness.rationale: For p specialist rows, q generalist rows, a core and b peripheral columns with all four positive, E=(p+q)a+qb. The four blocks of B_ij=A_ij-d_i e_j/E are specialist-core +qb/E; specialist-peripheral -aq/E; generalist-core -pb/E; generalist-peripheral +pa/E. Any partition can include at most the positive entries, and the unique two-module partition specialist+core/generalist+peripheral includes all positive and no negative entries; connectivity within each positive complete block enforces uniqueness up to relabeling. Hence Qmax=2abpq/E². With X=(p+q)a,Y=qb, 4XY<=(X+Y)^2 gives Q<=p/[2(p+q)] exactly at X=Y. Integer choices a=q,b=p+q attain equality; fixed m=p+q maximum occurs at q=1 and is (m-1)/(2m), limit 1/2. All partitions, not merely bipartitions, are covered by the sign-table bound; p+q>=3 prevents an already known 2-row special case.
